suite: V2.4.8 — Android Build, Bridge Integration & Purchase Recovery
note: V2.4.8 adds 11 new suites on top of V2.4.7's 121: concurrent billing flow prevention (BILLING_IN_PROGRESS guard, billingFlowInProgress reset on all paths including onPurchasesUpdated, error paths, destroy), AtomicLong-based callback ID generation (replaces System.nanoTime to prevent overflow), queryPurchases-based purchase recovery (replaces in-memory unresolvedPurchaseJson — recovery now uses Google Play queryPurchasesAsync as authoritative source surviving process restart, activity recreation, and WebView reload), JS shim updated (getUnresolvedPurchase removed, __PlayBillingRecoveryReady flag set instead), purchase token logging prevention verified, BILLING_IN_PROGRESS error structured for web layer, end-to-end recovery flow (verify → claim → fulfill → consume). Android build blocked by dl.google.com proxy restriction — documented as external prerequisite.
